value.rationale: Precisely characterizes semantic well-definedness of all positive instantial operations on arbitrary finite poset upset lattices. The criterion is necessary and sufficient, structurally interpretable in terms of maximal-point witness persistence and down-closure co-witness persistence, and strictly expands the previously imposed sufficient frame class at the smallest possible nontrivial order. It is motivated by an actual central semantics gap, not a numerical increment.
